_README: THE VOICE. Families, the size ramp, line height, letter tracking.
AN ABSENT KEY INHERITS. A PRESENT KEY WINS. See `plex-large`, which lists
only the sizes it changes and takes the families from `plex-docs`.
`webfont-text` and `webfont-code` are the only two values here that are NOT
a style: they name the families Material DOWNLOADS. `none` means download
nothing. They are all-or-nothing (one of each fails the build) and they are
SITE-WIDE -- a per-page theme cannot change them.

_base.note: The fallback every other row lands on. Must be complete.
_base.font-mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

plex-docs.note: The house voice. One family, hierarchy from weight and space rather than size.
plex-docs.font-mono: 'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, monospace

plex-large.note: Same family, everything up a step. A callboard screen, or reading at arm's length.

system-quick.note: No webfont at all. Instant first paint on a bad connection.
